**Claim:** PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q` (`domain:ui` execution seat) — branch `claude/issue-6295-rowcolor-prototype-guard`. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` in the same label write.

## Pre-dispatch gate

**1. Thread read.** Triage direction (18:04:37Z) read and adopted verbatim.

**2. Shadow check.** Two PRs of this seat's are in the merge queue touching `packages/plugin-grid/` — `#6370` (`ObjectGrid.tsx`, `data-table.tsx`) and `#6377` (`ObjectGrid.tsx`, `bulkEligibility.ts`, `BulkActionDialog.tsx`, `rowCrudAffordances.ts`). **Neither touches `useRowColor.ts`.** No hold. Merge `origin/main` again before you push.

**3. Premise re-measured live @ `origin/main`:**
```
packages/plugin-grid/src/useRowColor.ts:52   return COLOR_TO_CLASS[lower];
packages/plugin-grid/src/useRowColor.ts:67   const color = config.colors[value];
```
Both unguarded index reads are still there.

## Scope

`packages/plugin-grid/src/useRowColor.ts`. Both object literals inherit `Object.prototype`, so a record whose colour field holds `constructor` / `toString` / `valueOf` / `hasOwnProperty` resolves to an inherited **function**. `if (!color)` passes it (functions are truthy) and `colorToClass` then calls `.startsWith` on it — a **render crash of the grid, triggered by record data rather than by metadata**.

Guard **both** reads with `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, key)`.

⚠️ **The workspace compiles against the ES2020 lib, so `Object.hasOwn` is NOT available.** Reaching for it is the obvious move and it will not typecheck. Verify the lib setting yourself rather than taking my word for it — but do not spend the run rediscovering this.

**Cover the quieter half in the same pass.** `COLOR_TO_CLASS[lower]` at `:52` has the same shape one call deeper. It does **not** throw — it hands an `Object.prototype` member back as the row's `className` and reaches React as a class attribute. Silent, not loud, and the same defect. Fixing only the thrower leaves it.

**Precedent to match:** `#6178` / PR `#6294` did the analogous lookup guard in `packages/plugin-detail/src/headerColor.ts`. Read it and mirror it rather than inventing a second shape.

## Tests

- Pin a case whose field value is literally `constructor` — the card reproduced the exact expression chain, so encode that.
- Cover the quiet half too: assert `COLOR_TO_CLASS` cannot emit an inherited member as a className.
- ⛔ **Ghost-assertion guard (mandatory):** run each new assertion against unmodified `origin/main` first, capture it **failing** (the `constructor` case should throw the `TypeError`), then capture it passing. Both readings in the PR body.
- ⛔ **Degenerate-control guard:** keep a normal case (`open` → `bg-green-100`) so the guard is shown not to have broken ordinary lookups. Say which fixture is the control.

## Boundaries

⛔ Scope is these two index reads. Do not refactor the colour resolution, do not change the authored `colors` map shape, do not touch `plugin-detail`'s already-fixed sibling.

## Ground rules

Worktree-first: `git worktree add ../objectui-6295 -b claude/issue-6295-rowcolor-prototype-guard main && cd ../objectui-6295 && pnpm install`. ⛔ Never `git stash` — the stack lives in the common `.git` dir and is shared across every worktree of this repo. ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`. Changeset: `patch`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`. Run the repo's fast checks before pushing. Open the PR as **draft** with `Fixes #6295` and report back — the PM lands it, ⛔ never self-merge.

Size: S. Model: opus (this seat's default tier; the triage note suggested sonnet, but the tier order stands).

Notes for the PM, outside the machine-parsed block:

- **No `skip-changeset` label touched.** This PR ships a real `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, so the label is moot — and that label mechanism does not exist in this repo, so applying one would have minted a repository label the next agent could misread as real.
- **Bounded adjacent scan, nothing filed.** I checked whether the same defect class appears elsewhere: a module-level literal map indexed by a variable across `packages/plugin-*/src`. Six other sites, none of them the same defect. The `plugin-chatbot` and `plugin-form` sites are numeric-keyed, so no prototype member name can reach them. `plugin-view/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx` (`DEFAULT_VIEW_LABELS[view.type]`, `DEFAULT_VIEW_ICONS[view.type]`) is typed `Record<ViewType, ...>` against a union, and its icon path runs the string through `toPascalCase` first, which neutralises every lower-case prototype member exactly as the lower-casing does in this card's quiet half. I deliberately did **not** file an issue there: the only residual exposure is off-spec authored metadata, and filing it would invite a lenient renderer-side fallback, which AGENTS.md #0.1 bans in favour of rejecting at the producer. Flagging the reasoning rather than the ticket so you can overrule it if you disagree.
